description: This PHP script handles the saving of tab groups in SuiteCRM Studio module. It instantiates a TabGroupHelper object, saves tab groups based on POST data, and redirects the user to the appropriate page based on the language parameter.

classes.name: TabGroupHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing tab groups in SuiteCRM Studio module.

methods.name: saveTabGroups
methods.description: Method to save tab group settings based on user POST input.
